validation.evidence: Parent confirmed frozen targeted exit0; independently read six standard-axiom exports. No reviewer build.

checks: RequestAt annotates existing Cert constructors with exact dependent request/outcome indices. Here includes every node including zero fuel, guard failure, precompile and no-selected-child leaves. Recursive constructors match all selected edges and X continuation, including error/revert ancestors.

cert_top reconstructs literal enclosing certificate; cert_inner obtains actual inner certificate by location induction; sound_inner invokes existing Cert soundness. No fresh interpreter or arbitrary simulated execution is introduced.

compose concatenates event paths. At here, complete Cert determinism identifies nested surrounding tree with enclosing body; arbitrary innerTree cannot escape this certificate constraint. Transparent wrappers intentionally share paths, and no request uniqueness/count theorem is claimed.
theta_projection is a dependent family discriminating the located request, with all Theta branches mapped to exact ThetaAt constructors. Actual fuel/args/full outcome/tree/path remain identical.

Every quantifies all actual RequestAt nodes including root; Every.root requires actual root certificate. Every.descendant uses compose and remains conditional on genuine inner locations, so arbitrary tree argument does not add fabricated execution facts.
NoOutOfFuel is only the absence of actual evaluator OutOfFuel for every request kind. It permits returned false status, revert and other errors; no protocol/gas equivalence is asserted.

lambda_returns first derives exact actual lambda result through sound_inner, then uses independently proved CreationErrorScope.lambda_error to classify every Lambda exception as OutOfFuel. Every NoOutOfFuel excludes that case, yielding some returned tuple, not success=true.
scope_limits: Every NoOutOfFuel is an explicit all-node premise until a constructive resource producer supplies it. Module does not infer it from top-level successful execution.
Caught Lambda errors remain a real risk without that premise; parent .ok alone is insufficient.
Path nonuniqueness across transparent wrappers is intentional; relation cannot be used as distinct request enumeration without further identity/ownership proof.
No committed journal/history extraction, protocol admission or whole-guarantee closure.
